description: Scanning the minimal-agent-skills fixture detects exactly one `skill` node at the open-standard path `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with no issues. `agent-skills` is the stable, locked open default lens (a `.agents/` project also auto-detects it); the fixture pins `activeProvider: agent-skills` for determinism. Under its lens the provider classifies the file as `provider: agent-skills, kind: skill` rather than falling through to the universal `core/markdown` base.
